note: Instruments dropped from the csi-all universe for this window because the provider stops publishing daily bars mid-window and never resumes. Each reason names the upstream fact (provider last daily date, in-window session count) so the drop is re-derivable by re-querying tushare daily for the same window. The readiness gate refuses any exclusion that is not genuinely defective: a name at the session floor with no unexplained gap blocks as unjustified_exclusion.
